policies.title: Jamaican ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board nationality table expressly lists Jamaica as eligible to obtain a visitor visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Jamaican passport holder travelling as a short visitor; the table states that the arrival visa costs 40 JOD.
Jordan's live page says non-Jordanian travellers must complete Gateway2Jordan registration and receive a QR code before departure.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, particular border-crossing restrictions and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Jordan Tourism Board visa requirements
steps: Complete the required Gateway2Jordan registration and receive its QR code before departure.
Present the ordinary Jamaican passport at a Jordanian arrival point that issues visitor visas.
Pay the stated 40-JOD arrival-visa fee and satisfy immigration's final admission requirements.

policies.title: Jamaican ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free visitor entry
policies.summary: Grenada's actively linked April 2024 Embassy schedule expressly classifies Jamaica as requiring no visa for entry.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Jamaican passport holder visiting Grenada; the schedule defines 'No Visa Required' as 'Visa not required for entry'.
The schedule does not state one Jamaican stay limit; it says visitor permission beyond an approved 14-day, 30-day, 60-day, 90-day or six-month period requires a visa.
Work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope; admission remains subject to Grenada immigration control.
